type: miniature gas-discharge switching dekatron (counting tube with individual cathode outputs)
source: One-page reference sheet, image supplied by the owner on 2026-11-01, kept as doc/data/a110_sheet.png (no URL known)
digitized: 2026-11-01, transcribed from the sheet by hand. The sheet has no curves.
description: Miniature gas-discharge switching dekatron, intended for counting and counting-decision devices. Glass bulb, baseless (РШ27). Filled with a deionizing gas mixture. Blue glow, read visually by the position of the discharge glow.

electrical.name: control pulse amplitude
electrical.note: single value, no tolerance, no polarity and no duration printed

electrical.name: reset pulse amplitude
electrical.note: printed as '> 150 V'; the electrode it is applied to, polarity and duration are not printed

pinout_note: 13 flexible leads. All ten main cathodes have their own leads; each guide set is one lead. The sheet shows no pin numbering on the drawing and no key position for the lead order.

dimensions.note: horizontal dimension from the dome end to the pip, as drawn; the drawing does not make clear whether it ends at the pip axis or its far edge

notes: No tolerances, no min/max ratings table, no capacitances, no curves, no guide bias, no pulse widths or polarity, no cathode resistor value. Tolerances are not given anywhere; the dimensions carry no max/min marks.
